title: Host Patterns, Parallelism, and Facts
objective: Target precise host sets and inspect facts without changing systems.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Inventory patterns select groups, intersections, exclusions, or individual hosts. Ansible fans module work across a configurable number of forks, so verify the pattern before a broad operation.
The setup module gathers hardware, network, platform, and runtime facts. Filter fact output when investigating one property instead of flooding the terminal.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Target precise host sets and inspect facts without changing systems.

examples.title: Working design artifact

inspection:
  target: webservers
  module: ansible.builtin.setup
  filter: ansible_distribution*
